title: Mobile finance app
summary: A phone-sized personal finance app on one fixed dataset: balance and activity tabs, a grouped transaction list, and a four-step send-money flow with an on-screen keypad, a confirmation sheet and a success screen.
watchFor: Does it feel like an app or a shrunken website?
Tab transitions, the sheet slide-up and tap feedback
Does the new transfer really appear and the balance update?
interaction: Open Activity and scroll, back to Home, then Send: pick Maya Patel, type 42.50 on the keypad, Review, Confirm, Done.
